user.title: Connect to C-Gate
user.description: Enter the C-Gate server details. The default ports are C-Gate's plaintext command (20023), event (20024) and load-change (20025) ports.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to C-Gate, or the project could not be selected. Check the host, ports, project name, and that C-Gate's access.txt allows this client.

abort.already_configured: This C-Gate project/network is already configured.
